title: Tech Note: Error Handling with Call Chains
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The Get call chain command introduced around v17R6/v18 remains a current, actively used 4D API for building rich error handlers and diagnostic logging; this note's pattern of combining it with GET LAST ERROR STACK and JSON logging is still standard practice today.
related_updates: Get call chain is still documented and supported in current 4D versions with no changes to its core behavior

JSON-based structured error logging remains best practice; 4D has since added further error/exception handling capabilities (e.g., try/catch-style constructs in later versions) that can complement, not replace, this technique
